tenderSchedule.description: e-Tender for a) extracting, converting into pulpwood and staking the pulpwood with bark/debark at plantation site, loading, transporting and unloading of Eucalyptus/Acacia/Subabool pulpwood to different industries AND/OR b) extracting, converting into pulpwood and staking the pulpwood with bark/ debark at plantation site, loading into lorry at the various plantations existing within the jurisdiction of Dharwad Division during 2026-27 as detailed in the schedule Annexed
tenderSchedule.deptName: Karnataka State Forest Development Corporation Limited

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All terms and conditions as per tender documents

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Bidders should have experience of extraction of pulpwood and loading or extraction of pulpwood and transportation at least one year in Government/Public Sector Undertaking/Corporations
Previous Year Income Tax Return FY 2025-26
